scheme_name: Star College Scheme For Strengthening Of Science Education And Training At Undergraduate Level
other_conditions: College must be government or government‑aided (including autonomous) and recognised under Section 2(f)/12(B) of the UGC Act 1956.
Must offer at least 4‑5 undergraduate science courses (e.g., botany, zoology, applied life science, microbiology, physiology/biochemistry, biotechnology) and 1‑2 applied/PG diploma courses.
Must have adequate in‑house faculty expertise in each science department.
Must have independent laboratories and lecture halls with capacity for the sanctioned student strength.
Must have basic laboratory and library infrastructure, LCD/overhead projection facilities, and computers with internet access.

Colleges discontinued after a support round can re‑apply only after a two‑year cooling period; colleges already supported can apply for additional departments after completing one three‑year support cycle.
benefits_summary: Provides a one‑time grant of ₹10 lakh per science department plus an annual recurring grant of ₹3 lakh for three years, along with additional mentoring, monitoring and contingency funds.
